$Comment: A normal daily: life essence shaken loose at the Sawmill. STATION_OUTPUT on the exact essence id, qualified to the Sawmill, so essence from any other source does not count; the mill pays it as a lucky find on top of the planks, so this contract rewards a practised woodcutter rather than a stocked chest. Weight 1 keeps it an even draw against its rivals for the normal slot. This file spells out its whole step and pay rather than inheriting a shared skeleton, so it loads with nothing but this pack, RPG Stations and the MMO installed; it hangs on the Daily board by id, and on a server with no board of that id it is simply never posted. The stations feature gate in Requires is for a server where stations have been switched off: a board draws its slots without reading a contract's Requires, so the gate refuses at Accept rather than keeping the contract off the board.
